content.short: Petra Wallet is the official self-custodial flagship wallet for Aptos, designed by Aptos Labs for ease of use.
content.description:
Petra Wallet is the definitive, self-custodial digital asset manager built natively for the Aptos blockchain by the expert team at Aptos Labs. Designed to provide a seamless and highly secure user experience, the wallet supports advanced features such as social logins (Google/Apple), biometric authentication, and deep integration with the entire Aptos dApp ecosystem. Users can manage their tokens, trade NFTs, and interact with DeFi protocols within a transparent and intuitive interface.

The wallet also features a built-in "Earn" section, enabling one-click participation in network staking and lending directly from the extension or mobile app. By leveraging Aptos's high-speed infrastructure, Petra Wallet delivers near-instant transaction finality and robust cryptographic security. As the primary gateway for the Aptos network, Petra is dedicated to providing the essential infrastructure needed for mass adoption, empowering participants to maintain total sovereignty over their digital identity and capital in the evolving Web3 landscape.
content.meta: Petra Wallet is the leading self-custodial wallet for the Aptos blockchain, featuring secure asset management and dApp interaction.
